request.spec:
A year entry and a button generate the four calendar quarters of that year as periods named
<yyyy>-Q1 to <yyyy>-Q4, each as the period form would add it (a quarter that exists or overlaps is
left out); show how many were made.

agent.result_text:
The new "generate quarters" feature works and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` now pass. Getting there also needed a small fix to existing person-edit code (explained below).

**Quarters feature**
- **Server:** I added `PeriodService.generateQuarters` (`src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/period/PeriodService.java`). It goes through Q1–Q4 of the year, from the first day of each quarter to its last, named `yyyy-Q1` to `yyyy-Q4`. A quarter is skipped if a period already has that name or overlaps its dates. Otherwise it is added through the same `add` method the period form uses, so it writes the same `PERIOD_ADDED` audit line. The new endpoint is `POST /generate-quarters` in `PeriodController`, and it refuses a year that isn't four digits.
- **Front end:** In the period generate form (`periods.ts`) there's now a year box (`period-generate-quarters-year`) and a "Generate quarters" button (`period-generate-quarters`). It reuses the existing "Made:" count (`period-generated`) and error (`period-generate-error`), which are cleared when the button is pressed or the year is changed. `periods.service.ts` has the matching `generateQuarters` call.
- **Test result:** with P1 (1–10 May) already there, generating 2026 makes 3 quarters and leaves out Q2. Typing "x" is refused, and generating 2026 again makes 0.

**Fix to existing code**
"Scenario 1" failed on both of my first two runs, at a person-edit step that has nothing to do with periods. Every time a person was saved, the server recorded their grade as starting from the sheet's today, even if the grade hadn't changed. So after an edit that only changed terms, a later grade change dated earlier (B from 2026-02-10) was overruled by that "C from 2026-03-10" record, and the save showed C instead of B. I changed `PersonService.update` so that saving an unchanged grade with no from-date adds no new dated grade. After that, all 4 tests passed.
